clauses: When a card is depleted, it is flipped facedown
Depleted card cannot be used for the remainder of the mission
findings.rationale: Direct oracle test (B-I-PREDEFEAT-003) exercises depletion path and verifies card removal from attachments.

clauses: At the end of each mission, all depleted cards are flipped faceup
Depletion array must not be reset by any game code path
findings.rationale: Invariant pin across multiple source files verifies no-reset invariant and proper depletion array presence.

clauses: Non-companion figure cannot end movement in space occupied by another non-companion figure
Unless moving figure has Massive keyword (exception)
findings.rationale: Tests 005e and 005a directly verify blocked endpoint and Massive bypass respectively.

clauses: Some effects are triggered when figure enters space (movement)
Some effects are triggered when figure enters space (push)
Some effects are triggered when figure enters space (placement)
missing: Tests only cover Rush and Block-token entry triggers (movement-based adjacency effects); does not comprehensively cover all entry-triggered effects
findings.rationale: Oracle test verifies specific entry triggers (Rush, Block) but does not exhaustively validate all entry-trigger categories.

clauses: Some effects are triggered when figure exits space (move-out)
Some effects are triggered when figure exits space (push-out)
Some effects are triggered when figure exits space (placement-away)
missing: Test only verifies Dio Follow exit trigger (movement-based); does not comprehensively cover push-exit or placement-away exit triggers
findings.rationale: Oracle test covers one exit-trigger type (movement) but does not exhaustively validate all exit-trigger categories.

clauses: Mobile figures ignore additional movement point costs when entering difficult terrain
Mobile figures ignore additional movement point costs when entering spaces with hostile figures
findings.rationale: PROBE-MOB-001 directly asserts ignoreDifficult=true for Mobile; PROBE-MOB-003 covers ignoreFigureCost.

clauses: Mobile figures ignore terrain for movement
Mobile figures can move through impassable terrain
Mobile figures can enter blocking terrain
findings.rationale: PROBE-MOB-002 directly asserts ignoreBlocking=true for Mobile figures; probe comment confirms full coverage.

clauses: Mobile figure occupying blocking terrain can still be seen/traced for LOS purposes
missing: Invariant pin verifies hasLineOfSight skips blocking-set lookup (source-level check); behavioral LOS coverage when Mobile occupies blocking terrain not fully exercised
findings.rationale: Test confirms source-level blocking-set skip but lacks end-to-end behavioral validation of LOS from Mobile-occupied blocking spaces.

clauses: All figures move one space at a time
findings.rationale: Test 001a verifies 1 MP reaches adjacent spaces only (a2, b1, b2 from a1), confirming one-space-at-a-time rule.

clauses: Large figures cannot move diagonally in a single step
findings.rationale: Test 004a explicitly verifies 2x2 figures only reach orthogonal destinations at cost 1 (no diagonals).

clauses: When figure performs Move action, it gains movement points equal to its Speed
missing: Invariant pin verifies Move-action handler branch exists and Speed mapping exists in code; behavioral exercise with variable Speed values not covered
findings.rationale: Source-level check confirms handler code path exists but lacks behavioral proof that all Speed values correctly map to MP grants.

clauses: Gaining movement points does not itself move the figure
missing: Unit test is embedded in headless activation-combat integration flow; does not isolate Move-action grant in pure unit context
findings.rationale: Evidence provided is integration-level test, not focused isolation of Move-action grant semantics.

clauses: Move action completes immediately after granting movement points
missing: Invariant pin verifies dc_move handler branch exists; behavioral exercise of action-completion flow end-to-end not covered
findings.rationale: Source-level check for handler branch but no behavioral proof of immediate action completion post-MP-grant.

clauses: Movement points can be gained from sources other than Move action
missing: Unit test embedded in abilities flow; does not isolate non-Move MP sources as distinct test case
findings.rationale: Test is integration-level (abilities initialization), not a focused unit test of non-Move MP sources.

clauses: Figures without Massive or Mobile cannot enter blocking terrain
Figures without Massive or Mobile cannot be pushed into blocking terrain
findings.rationale: Direct oracle test verifies non-Mobile/non-Massive figures cannot cross blocking-terrain barriers.

clauses: Massive figures ignore terrain for movement
findings.rationale: Test 005b explicitly verifies Massive ignores difficult-terrain additional movement cost.

clauses: Figures cannot move through walls
Figures cannot move through doors
missing: Test only covers door blocking (003a); "walls" term not explicitly distinguished from doors in test assertions
findings.rationale: Doors validated but wall-specific movement blocking not evidenced as distinct test case.

clauses: Figures cannot move through closed doors
findings.rationale: Test 003a directly verifies closed door blocks direct movement (r11→r12).

clauses: Figure may interleave MP spending around non-Move actions
missing: Invariant pin checks that dc_spend_mp_ handler is registered; behavioral exercise of MP interleave (spend-move-spend sequence) not directly tested
findings.rationale: Source-level check for handler registration but no behavioral proof of actual MP interleave flow.

clauses: Figures can move diagonally along the corner of any individual wall/door/blocking terrain
missing: Invariant pin verifies canMoveDiagonally returns OR of two flanking corners (source-level); behavioral test does not exhaustively verify all corner-flank types
findings.rationale: Source-level logic check for diagonal OR but behavioral coverage incomplete across different terrain-corner configurations.

clauses: Figure cannot move through the diagonal intersection where two walls/doors seal both flanks
missing: Behavioral test provided (014a) but does not exhaustively verify all two-wall-seal combinations (different terrain types, orientations)
findings.rationale: Test covers some seal scenarios but does not comprehensively validate all flank-sealing configurations.

clauses: Large figure may rotate 90° by spending 1 movement point
findings.rationale: Test 001a verifies rotation produces endpoint at same topLeft with rotated size.

clauses: Additional movement point costs apply to rotation if Large figure does not end in clear footprint
findings.rationale: Test verifies baseline rotation into difficult cell costs 2 MP (1 base + 1 difficult).

clauses: Move X Spaces effects ignore movement point costs (terrain costs, hostile-figure costs, etc)
Move X Spaces effects allow bypass of cost restrictions
findings.rationale: Test pin verifies moveXBypassActive flag gates bypass behavior and handler checks confirm cost bypass.

clauses: Move X Spaces still obeys non-cost terrain restrictions (blocking, impassable)

findings.rationale: Source-level check for getMovementTarget usage but no behavioral proof that all restriction types are enforced during Move X.

clauses: Unused move-up-to-X movement cannot be saved for later
Movement bank is tracked per-activation message ID

clauses: During Move X Spaces effect, Large figure base cannot rotate

clauses: Figure may only enter a space it could legally end movement in

clauses: Entering a space containing difficult terrain costs 1 additional movement point

clauses: Figures do not block line of sight to or from a Massive figure

clauses: Massive figures ignore terrain for movement
findings.rationale: Test 005c confirms Massive ignores blocking-terrain movement restrictions.

clauses: Massive figures can enter spaces containing hostile figures
findings.rationale: Test 005a asserts Massive can end on occupied spaces (canEndOnOccupied=true).

clauses: Massive figures cannot enter spaces containing other Massive figures
